# P2 self-verdict threshold and H1d power (generated by analysis/p2_selfverdict.py; dev split only)

Verbal score s = log P(yes) − log P(no). Threshold t* maximizes dev balanced accuracy (design §5.7). H1d is re-assembled from the dev 1A rows (one generation per item × verdict value); unobserved cells are imputed from their stratum's rate. Power: two-sided paired test, n = 1455, level α/6 (first Holm step), 200 permutations.
